Basketball channels carry tournament broadcasts • Online Audio: NCAA March Madness Live and TuneIn Radio Radio coverage includes play-by-play broadcasts for tournament games throughout March Madness. 💻 HOW TO WATCH MARCH MADNESS ONLINE Fans can stream NCAA Tournament games through: • NCAA March Madness Live • Paramount+ (CBS games) • TBS, TNT, and truTV streaming apps • YouTube TV, Hulu Live TV, Sling TV, and FuboTV These platforms carry the networks broadcasting the entire NCAA Tournament schedule. 📊 MARCH MADNESS BETTING INFORMATION Sportsbooks typically release betting markets immediately after the bracket is revealed. Common NCAA Tournament betting options include: • Point Spread • Total (Over/Under) • Moneyline • First Half Lines • Tournament Futures (National Champion) • Region Winner Odds • Final Four Odds Opening betting lines can change quickly as sportsbooks adjust to betting activity and bracket matchups. 🏀 INTERESTING MARCH MADNESS FACTS • The NCAA Tournament began in 1939 and has grown into one of the largest sporting events in the United States. • The Final Four determines the national champion after teams advance through four regional rounds. • The tournament’s single-elimination format creates the possibility of upsets and Cinderella runs each year. • Millions of fans fill out March Madness brackets each year as part of tournament pools and contests.
